highlights.label: Tool software
highlights.text: Developed C++/MFC software for tool automation, measurement-data processing, and operator interfaces.

highlights.label: Wafer mapping accuracy
highlights.text: Improved virtual wafer die-map reconstruction accuracy from approximately 70% to nearly 95%, using four calibration points across three adjacent dies; checked through practical tool measurements.

highlights.label: Faster autofocus
highlights.text: Reduced long-range autofocus time from over 10 seconds to 2–3 seconds by correcting stage tilt with a virtual plane and position-dependent Z-axis adjustment.

highlights.label: 3D image stitching
highlights.text: Implemented 3D height-data image stitching from scratch to reconstruct a full die beyond one camera field of view.

highlights.label: Pattern recognition & CUDA
highlights.text: Developed OpenCV pattern recognition for wafer-die structure inspection and applied CUDA to image processing.

highlights.label: Requirements engineering
highlights.text: Translated flight-operations requirements into specifications, UI wireframes, and crew-training and certification rules.

paragraphs: I’m a C++ software engineer based in Leipzig, Germany, and an MSc Automotive Software Engineering student at TU Chemnitz.

At Frontier Semiconductor Metrology, I developed C++/MFC software for semiconductor tool automation, measurement-data processing, and operator interfaces. My R&D work included wafer mapping, position-dependent autofocus compensation, 3D height-data image stitching, and OpenCV/CUDA image processing.

I enjoy object-oriented programming, algorithms, data structures, and practical problem-solving. I’ve solved 500+ problems across platforms and contests including Codeforces, CodeChef, ICPC, and UVa, and 140+ problems on LeetCode, and earned two first-place finishes in Intra-AUST programming contests.

My current MSc coursework covers Hardware–Software Codesign, Image Understanding, and AI for Mobile Robots. My engineering toolkit includes Linux CLI, SSH, Git, unit testing, Agile practices, and code refactoring.
